units.rawText: I know you've only just joined us, but we've brought you to a place like this already. There's no need to worry, though. All the rescue missions here have pretty much been completed.

units.rawText: Earthquake 2057 in Richmond measured 6.0 on the Richter Scale. Three hours after receiving word of the earthquake, Baltimore FD's Team 1 took part in the rescue operation.

units.rawText: The mainshock did not affect the new city center, but it did quite a bit of damage to the old city area. Fortunately, the mainshock took place during the day, and most of the inhabitants had already evacuated to disaster shelters.
units.displayText: The mainshock did not affect the new city center, but it did quite a bit of damage to the old city area. Fortunately, the mainshock took place during the day, and most of the inhabitants had already evacuated to disaster shelters.

units.rawText: That, combined with the fact that the earthquake did not trigger large-scale secondary damage, means that casualties from the quake were on the low side.

units.rawText: Currently, our main objective is to clear obstacles in the old city area. Due to the complex underground infrastructure in the old city, our first priority is to eliminate the risk of fires and explosions. This is a map I've annotated with the risk levels of various regions.
